kind: Authored development common query-form probes: identical facts, documents, IDs and 48 encounter schedule to the actual projected-binding TRAIN; all sixteen requests use different natural forms; evaluator-only expectations; common probes do not add teaching exposures.

training.name: learn-akvo-transport
training.request: What transport setting does akvo require according to the notes? Apply it.
training.document: The service akvo uses black lotus for transport and celestine as its audit label. For brem, copper beech labels audit records; transport uses cinnabar. A maintenance checklist repeats akvo and brem under transport checks without supplying further settings.
